args.command:
set -euo pipefail
cat >/tmp/start_win311.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Start nginx web interface if available
if command -v nginx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nginx -g 'daemon on;'
fi
# Start QEMU in snapshot mode with VNC :1 and a monitor socket for programmatic control
exec qemu-system-i386 \
  -m 32 \
  -hda /app/isos/win311.img \
  -snapshot \
  -vnc :1 \
  -monitor unix:/tmp/win311-monitor.sock,server,nowait \
  -serial mon:stdio \
  -rtc base=localtime \
  -boot c
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/start_win311.sh
nohup /tmp/start_win311.sh >/tmp/win311.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
ps -ef | grep -E 'qemu-system-i386.*win311.img|start_win311.sh' | grep -v grep || true
ss -ltnp | grep -E ':5901|:80' || true
printf '--- qemu log ---\n'
sed -n '1,120p' /tmp/win311.log || true
